properties.name: selected_id
properties.comment: The selected item's stable ID, or empty; a view, since replacing the items keeps or clears it. A change raises selection_changed; an ID not in the model throws std::out_of_range.
hand: a view onto selected_id_, which set_items retains or clears; write_view validates and raises selection_changed

properties.name: pinned_id
properties.comment: The pinned (persistently expanded) item's stable ID, or empty; a view, since replacing the items keeps or clears it. A change keeps the visible anchor row, raises pin_changed, then expansion_changed for each item whose expansion changed; an ID not in the model throws std::out_of_range.
hand: a view onto pinned_id_, which set_items retains or clears; write_view anchors the scroll and raises pin_changed then expansion_changed

properties.name: compact_height
properties.comment: The height of a collapsed row before text scaling, 24 to 192 and below expanded_height (std::invalid_argument otherwise); a view, so a change can keep the visible anchor row.
hand: a view onto compact_height_; write_view captures and restores the scroll anchor around the change

properties.name: expanded_height
properties.comment: The height of an expanded row before text scaling, above compact_height and at most 512 (std::invalid_argument otherwise); a view, so a change can keep the visible anchor row.
hand: a view onto expanded_height_; write_view captures and restores the scroll anchor around the change

properties.name: status_rail_width
properties.comment: The width of each row's status rail, 1 to 12 (std::invalid_argument otherwise).
prepare: throw std::invalid_argument("CorrespondenceView status rail width must be finite and between 1 and 12");

properties.name: hover_intent_delay
properties.comment: How long the pointer must rest on a row before it expands, 1 ms to 5 s (std::invalid_argument otherwise). A change restarts a pending hover.
hand: prepare validates; written reschedules the hovered row's intent

properties.name: font
properties.comment: The rows' font (Font). Throws std::invalid_argument for an invalid FontSpec; any write marks the font as set from code.
prepare: if (!valid_font_spec(incoming)) throw std::invalid_argument("CorrespondenceView font is invalid");

properties.name: scroll_offset
properties.comment: The vertical scroll position, clamped to the content; a view, since the view's own anchoring and reveal move it. A negative or non-finite offset throws std::invalid_argument; a change ends a pending hover.
hand: a view onto scroll_offset_, which anchoring and reveal move directly; write_view clamps and clears the hover intent

not_properties.name: items
not_properties.reason: the model is replaced whole and validated as a set; collections stay methods
